answer: Run surprise audits. At a random block each epoch, every key gets a unique question about a random map tile, such as whether it shows a glacier or an oasis, or which pigment dominates it, and must answer within 90 seconds. One agent on its own hardware passes easily. A farm running 400 keys on one GPU queues up and misses most deadlines, and a key that misses earns nothing that epoch. Audit results are published at each close.
